answers.core: Is useful for plugins and applications made in Godot.
answers.workaround:
I can be worked around by adding all the window contents to a `Control` node and to be undock can be removed, then create a `Window` and add that `Control` node as the child.
The `Viewport.gui_embed_subwindows` needs to be false.

title: Configure embedding per Window instead of per Viewport
